name: Readymag
description_en:
Readymag is a visual website design and publishing service for portfolios, editorial projects, landing pages and client sites. Its canvas supports separate desktop/mobile/tablet layouts, typography, media, animation and widgets. Although this catalog assigns it to graphic design, the actual deliverable is a hosted interactive website rather than just a downloaded graphic.

Plan selection depends on published sites, mapped domains, aggregate monthly views, collaborators and file sizes. HTML export is restricted to Advanced/Extra and requires server configuration; it is not a promise of a freely editable, fully equivalent standalone application. Evaluate publishing and client handoff together with the design.
description_zh:
Readymag 是面向作品集、编辑项目、落地页及客户站点的可视化网站设计和发布服务，画布支持独立桌面/手机/平板布局、字体、媒体、动画及组件。虽然本目录将其分在图形设计，实际交付物是托管交互网站，并非只有下载图片。

选套餐要看已发布站点、绑定域名、所有站点合计月浏览量、协作者及文件大小。HTML 导出限 Advanced/Extra 并要求服务器配置，不承诺得到可自由编辑且完全等效的独立应用。应把设计、发布与客户交接一起评估。

sections.title_en: A web publishing tool inside a design workflow
sections.title_zh: 设计流程中的网站发布工具
sections.en:
The [plan guide](https://help.readymag.com/hc/en-us/articles/15790840333851-Understanding-Readymag-plans) describes customizable grids, separate device layouts, animation and font/photo resources. Paid plans include custom domain mapping, private sites, uploaded fonts, PDF export, hosting/SSL, sharing settings and analytics/SEO options. These support visually authored websites; they do not establish an arbitrary backend, database or production application integration.

Editorial fit: use Readymag for a designer-led portfolio, campaign microsite or editorial experience where layout and presentation are central. If the project depends on authenticated business transactions, complex structured content or independently maintained source code, validate those requirements separately before choosing it. A visually working preview is not proof the published site has every widget enabled.
sections.zh:
[方案指南](https://help.readymag.com/hc/en-us/articles/15790840333851-Understanding-Readymag-plans)介绍可定制网格、不同设备布局、动画及字体/照片资源。付费方案包含自定义域名、私密站点、上传字体、PDF 导出、托管/SSL、分享设置及分析/SEO 选项，适合可视化创作网站，但不证明具备任意后端、数据库或生产应用集成。

编辑建议：适合版式和展示为核心的设计师作品集、活动微站或编辑体验。如项目依赖身份验证的业务交易、复杂结构化内容或独立维护源码，应在选择前单独验证。预览看起来能运行，不证明正式发布时全部组件均启用。

sections.title_en: Plan the site, devices and recipient before publishing
sections.title_zh: 发布前规划站点、设备和接收方
sections.en:
A documentation-based campaign workflow is to start a project, lay out content for Desktop, Mobile and Tablet, add media and interactions, and check each layout in preview. Decide whether one Readymag-domain site is sufficient or whether a paid custom domain, password protection or client transfer is needed. For a handoff, the guide assigns Project transfer to Freelancer; confirm the recipient’s plan and resources rather than assuming the creator’s allowances travel with the project.

The Free plan permits one published site with at most 10 pages. Its broad “all widgets” claim needs the detailed matrix qualification: Forms, Shots, Lottie and custom code are preview-only. Paid plans lift the page count limit, but that does not remove plan limits on domains, views or uploads. Check the live URL, form behavior, mobile navigation, media and metadata after publishing. No site was actually created or transferred for this research.
sections.zh:
一个基于文档的活动流程是：新建项目，分别排版 Desktop、Mobile、Tablet，加入媒体和交互，并预览每种布局。先决定是否只需一个 Readymag 域名站点，还是需要付费自定义域名、密码保护或客户转移。指南把 Project transfer 列入 Freelancer；交接前应确认接收账户方案及资源，不能假定创作者额度随项目转移。

Free 可发布一个最多 10 页的站点。“全部组件”宣传需结合详细矩阵：Forms、Shots、Lottie 和自定义代码仅预览可用。付费取消页数上限，并不取消域名、浏览量或上传限制。发布后应检查真实 URL、表单、移动导航、媒体及元数据。本研究未实际创建或转移站点。

sections.title_en: Sites, domains and views are separate limits
sections.title_zh: 站点、域名与浏览量分别限制
sections.en:
The browser pricing snapshot displayed GBP: Personal £12/month billed yearly or £16 monthly; Freelancer £25 yearly-equivalent or £33 monthly; Advanced £44 yearly-equivalent or £49 monthly. These are the viewed currency and billing options, not a universal quote. Extra is custom. The help article’s generic “10%” annual discount does not match all current displayed pairs, so use the actual plan card and checkout rather than applying a blanket discount.

Personal includes one published site/custom domain, 10,000 views/month, one collaborator, 6 MB video uploads and six version snapshots. Freelancer has five published sites, three mapped domains, 25,000 views across all sites, two collaborators, 50 MB video and 12 snapshots. Advanced allows unlimited published sites but ten mapped domains and 75,000 aggregate monthly views, ten collaborators, 100 MB video and 44 snapshots, plus export/embed. Picture uploads are 6 MB per file in the table. Extra can negotiate resources and SSO/SLA. “Unlimited sites” does not mean unlimited traffic or domains.
sections.zh:
浏览器价格快照显示英镑：Personal 年付折合每月 £12 或月付 £16；Freelancer 年付折合 £25 或月付 £33；Advanced 年付折合 £44 或月付 £49。这是本次看到的币种及账期，不是统一报价，Extra 询价。帮助文档笼统的年付“10%”折扣与当前部分价格对不一致，应以实际卡片和结账为准，不统一套折扣。

Personal 含一个已发布站点/自定义域名、每月 10,000 浏览、1 位协作者、6 MB 视频上传和 6 个版本快照。Freelancer 为 5 个已发布站点、3 个域名、全部站点合计 25,000 浏览、2 位协作者、50 MB 视频和 12 个快照。Advanced 可无限发布站点，但限 10 个绑定域名、合计 75,000 月浏览、10 位协作者、100 MB 视频及 44 个快照，另含导出/嵌入。表格图片上传限制每文件 6 MB。Extra 可商定资源及 SSO/SLA。“无限站点”不等于无限流量或域名。

sections.title_en: HTML export requires a configured host
sections.title_zh: HTML 导出需要配置好的主机
sections.en:
The [export guide](https://help.readymag.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020647452-Code-export) uses the older Business (Advanced) name for Advanced and also includes Extra. Publish the project first, open Preview, choose the share icon, then Export → HTML. Supply the full destination URL; the archive is emailed to the account address. The archive includes index.html, build scripts/styles, images, crawler snippets, sitemap/robots files and sample Apache/NGINX configurations. Uploading files alone is insufficient: routing must be configured. The guide recommends a web developer.

For Apache, omitted or disabled .htaccess can cause non-first pages to return 404 when refreshed; the documented remedy is correct host configuration. NGINX similarly needs the provided routing rules. Use an appropriately secured production host; the article’s sample HTTP server block is not a complete TLS or operations specification. An exported archive and an iframe embed are different integration choices.
sections.zh:
[导出指南](https://help.readymag.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020647452-Code-export)用旧称 Business (Advanced) 指 Advanced，同时覆盖 Extra。先发布项目，在 Preview 打开分享图标，选择 Export → HTML，填写完整目标 URL，压缩包会发到账户邮箱。包内含 index.html、构建脚本/样式、图片、爬虫片段、sitemap/robots 及 Apache/NGINX 配置示例。只上传文件不足以运行，还必须配置路由，指南建议请网页开发者协助。

Apache 如漏传或未启用 .htaccess，刷新非首页可能出现 404；文档处理方式是正确配置主机。NGINX 同样需要相应路由。生产应使用适当安全的主机，文章中的 HTTP 示例不是完整 TLS 或运维规范。导出文件包与 iframe 嵌入是不同集成选择。

sections.title_en: Export is a snapshot with functional losses
sections.title_zh: 导出是带功能损失的快照
sections.en:
The export documentation says project content is JSON rendered with JavaScript and the exported project cannot be edited as a normal Readymag project. To change it, edit the project in the account, republish and export again. This is not an unrestricted visual source-editing round trip. The Form widget can send only to a custom URL after export; Google Docs, email and Mailchimp destinations do not work. Custom Open Graph and SEO tags are exported only for the first page.

For a brochure site, test deep-link refresh, all asset paths and page-specific search/share metadata on the destination host. For lead capture, supply and secure the custom endpoint and test its success/failure behavior. Do not budget for the hosted form destinations to survive export automatically. Continued font/media rights, runtime dependencies, accessibility and long-term export operability require separate checks. No exported project or endpoint was run here.
sections.zh:
导出文档说明内容是由 JavaScript 渲染的 JSON，导出项目不能像普通 Readymag 项目那样编辑。修改需回到账户编辑、重新发布并再次导出，不是无限制可视化源码往返。导出后 Form 只能发送到自定义 URL，Google Docs、邮件及 Mailchimp 目标不可用；自定义 Open Graph 和 SEO 标签只导出首页。

宣传站应在目标主机测试深层链接刷新、全部素材路径及各页搜索/分享元数据。收集线索时需自行提供安全的自定义端点并检查成功/失败行为，不能假定托管表单目标自动保留。字体/媒体权利、运行依赖、可访问性和长期可运行性仍需另查。本研究未运行导出项目或端点。

sections.title_en: Billing changes and the evidence boundary
sections.en:
The plan guide says changing plan or billing interval terminates the current subscription and puts unused balance into the account balance; this is not stated as a cash refund. Readymag includes hosting and SSL on paid plans, but actual domain ownership, renewal, resource overage behavior and uptime are operational questions. The pricing page’s one-year .xyz promotion and discount are not evidence of free domain renewal forever.

The current pricing page was read through a normal browser because the HTML reader returned only a JavaScript shell. Help articles were read as text; no login, purchase, deployment or account permissions were tested. HTML source export by itself does not establish that the Readymag platform or supplied runtime is open source. The governing software, media and contract terms remain unverified in this draft.
sections.zh:
方案指南表示改变方案或账期会终止当前订阅，并把未用余额退到账户余额，并未表述为现金退款。付费方案含托管和 SSL，但实际域名归属、续费、超额资源行为及可用率仍是运营问题。价格页的一年 .xyz 优惠和折扣不证明域名永久免费续费。

HTML 阅读器仅返回 JavaScript 外壳，因此当前价格页通过正常浏览器实读；帮助文章以文字实读，未登录、购买、部署或测试账户权限。能导出 HTML 源码本身不证明 Readymag 平台或附带运行时开源。本草稿仍未核实适用的软件、媒体和合同条款。

research_gaps.en: Governing service/asset licenses, exact checkout/taxes, resource-overage consequences, domain renewal, client transfer eligibility and post-subscription export dependencies need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 适用服务/素材许可、实际结账/税费、资源超额后果、域名续费、客户转移资格及订阅后导出依赖需确认。
